name: Recovery Code Accepted
summary: The anonymous user submits the valid six-digit recovery code, the server consumes the code and establishes password-reset authority, and the client advances to the new-password view.

preconditions.expression: session-capability == anonymous and auth.password.reset.sent is visible for a recoverable known account with a valid recovery code

inputs.name: Recovery Code
inputs.description: Six-digit password recovery code received through the verified email channel.

serverInteraction.intent: Verify and consume the six-digit recovery code and establish reset authority without exposing the password-reset token to the user.

postconditions.expression: session-capability == anonymous and auth.password.reset.complete is visible with password-reset authority established internally and the recovery code consumed

sourceReferences.note: VerifyPasswordResetCodeAsync verifies the six-digit code, consumes it, generates the password-reset token, and returns reset authority to the application flow.
Successful code verification is the point where Password Recovery Success diverges from Password Recovery Rejected.
